title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
description: Indy (Harrison Ford) and a young adventurer (Shia La Beouf) must ferret out a powerful artifact and keep it out of the hands of a deadly Soviet agent (Cate Blanchett).

title: Winchester
description: Ensconced in her sprawling San Jose, California mansion, eccentric firearm heiress Sarah Winchester believes she is haunted by the souls of people killed by the Winchester repeating rifle.

title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
description: A globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) must find Pandora's box before a maniacal scientist (Ciarán Hinds) can harness its power for world domination.

title: Bridget Jones's Diary
description: An outrageous British woman (Renée Zellweger) decides to take control of her life, but instead falls for two very different men (Colin Firth, Hugh Grant).

title: Smart People
description: Recently widowed, a professor (Dennis Quaid) tries to juggle a new love (Sarah Jessica Parker) and an unexpected visit from his adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church).

title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
description: An old and mysterious camcorder leads to the discovery of a supernatural terror in a family's new home.

title: Terminator: Dark Fate
description: Seasoned warrior Sarah Connor joins forces with a hybrid cyborg human and the T-800 model to protect a young woman from the Rev-9 -- a newly modified and seemingly indestructible liquid Terminator from the future.

title: 21 Jump Street
description: Two cops must confront their teenage angst all over again when they go undercover as high-school students.

title: 22 Jump Street
description: Officers Jenko and Schmidt begin to question their partnership after each infiltrates different cliques while undercover at a local college.

title: Masterminds
description: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him.

title: Fist Fight
description: Fired from his teaching job for losing his cool, a disgruntled man (Ice Cube) challenges the colleague (Charlie Day) who snitched on him to a fight after school.

title: Get Hard
description: The prison-bound manager of a hedge fund asks a Black businessman, who has never been to jail, to prepare him for life behind bars.

title: The Hangover
description: After a wild stag party in Las Vegas, three hazy groomsmen (Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis) must find their missing friend and get him back to Los Angeles in time for his wedding.

title: The Hangover Part II
description: Hoping to avoid the mayhem that marked his friend's Las Vegas bachelor party, Stu opts for what he thinks will be a safe prewedding brunch in Thailand.

title: The Hangover Part III
description: Phil, Stu and Doug take Alan on a road trip to help him through a personal crisis. Mr. Chow breaks out of prison and prepares to wreak havoc.

title: 300: Rise of an Empire
description: Xerxes, driven by vengeance for his father's death, leads an army against Greece; Greek city-states join forces under Athens' command to fight Artemisia in a naval battle.

title: Cop Land
description: The sheriff (Sylvester Stallone) of a small New Jersey police community confronts key men (Harvey Keitel, Ray Liotta) on both sides of a law-enforcement cover-up.

title: The Lovely Bones
description: A 14-year-old murder victim watches from heaven, as her family tries to heal and her killer continues on his own dark path.

title: The Firm
description: A law-school grad uncovers a sinister secret about the Tennessee firm that made him an offer he couldn't refuse.

title: Along Came a Spider
description: A detective (Morgan Freeman) and a Secret Service agent (Monica Potter) investigate the abduction of a senator's daughter from a school.

title: The Running Man
description: A police-state scapegoat (Arnold Schwarzenegger) must play a TV host's (Richard Dawson) deadly game show for the 21st-century masses.

title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
description: In the future a cutting-edge android in the form of a boy (Haley Joel Osment) embarks on a journey to discover his true nature.

title: Gravity
description: The destruction of their shuttle leaves two astronauts, Dr. Ryan Stone and Matt Kowalski, stranded in space with no hope of rescue.

title: Blade Runner 2049
description: After discovering a long-buried secret that jeopardizes what's left of society, a new Blade Runner embarks on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years.

title: Sweetness
description: When a fan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him.

title: House at the End of the Street
description: A divorcee (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter (Jennifer Lawrence) learn that they have moved next door to a house in which a girl killed her parents, then disappeared, leaving a brother (Max Thieriot) as the only survivor.

title: Kiss the Girls
description: After escaping from a serial killer, a doctor (Ashley Judd) helps police and a forensic psychologist (Morgan Freeman) track the madman.

title: Cheech & Chong Still Smokin'
description: When Cheech and Chong wind up in Amsterdam, they decide to organize a show in order to help out a flailing film festival.

title: The Last Exorcism Part II
description: Unable to remember the horrific events of her past, Nell Sweetzer tries to rebuild her life in New Orleans. However, a demonic force soon returns with sinister plans for her.

title: The Dark Tower
description: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, must prevent the Man in Black (Matthew McConaughey) from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together.

title: Brave the Dark
description: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart.

title: Argo
description: During the Iran hostage crisis, an extraction specialist (Ben Affleck) in the CIA poses as a Hollywood film producer to rescue six Americans who eluded Iranian militants and found refuge with the Canadian ambassador.

title: My Cousin Vinny
description: Two New Yorkers accused of murder in rural Alabama while on their way back to college call in the help of one of their cousins, a loudmouth lawyer with no trial experience.

title: True Grit
description: A teenage girl (Hailee Steinfeld) enlists the aid of a boozy, trigger-happy lawman (Jeff Bridges) to hunt down her father's killer (Josh Brolin).

title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
description: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.

title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark

title: Congo
description: Killer gorillas menace an ex-CIA agent (Laura Linney), a primatologist (Dylan Walsh) and others on a mission in Africa.

title: Godzilla
description: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation.

title: The Bodyguard
description: An ex-secret service agent falls for his client, an actress and singer someone wants dead before the Academy Awards.
